overview: The Federated States of Micronesia is a country of more than 600 islands in the western Pacific. Its capital is Palikir, on the island of Pohnpei. It is made up of four states: Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei and Kosrae. Micronesia became independent in 1986 and has a close association with the United States.

geography.text: The islands range from high volcanic islands such as Pohnpei and Kosrae, which are mountainous and covered in rainforest, to low coral atolls. Pohnpei is one of the wettest places on Earth. Off its coast lies Nan Madol, an ancient city of stone built on small artificial islands, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
